assay: bulk RNA-seq, vastus lateralis biopsies, human pre-menopausal untrained females
primary_estimand: Within-person change in the muscle transcriptome from before (PRE) to after (POST) a 12-week supervised resistance-training programme (the transcriptomic arm of a testosterone-association paper).
planned_contrasts: POST vs PRE resistance training (S3.6.p1: 214 DEGs, 122 up, 92 down)
paper_method: DESeq2, model Genes ~ ID + timepoint (ID accounts for repeated measures) (S2.14.p6)
paper_filter: genes with mean across all samples <= 10 reads removed, 14,979 genes retained (S2.12.6.p1)
paper_samples: 35 pre-training, 27 post-training biopsies (FIG7 legend; S3.p1: 35 enrolled, 27 completed)
paper_results: 214 DEGs POST vs PRE, 122 up, 92 down, FDR<0.05; ChEA3 TF enrichment on DEGs (AR ranked 284/1632)
